correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructed: for point mask A and selected eligible line mask B, the minimal-complement recurrence replaces the point mask by missing points plus points on eligible missing lines and B by those lines. 2^e(A) over all 128 point subsets gives 458 valid ideals. A separately implemented all-state enumeration obtained precisely 29 length-3, 35 length-5, 28 length-7 cycles, totaling 458, and an independently constructed 168-element GL3(F2) action gave seven orbits with (period, cardinality sum, orbit size) (3,18,14),(3,21,1),(3,24,14),(5,32,7),(5,35,21),(5,38,7),(7,49,28). Group equivariance follows from incidence preserving order; orbit disjointness and state exhaustion make finite census exhaustive. Scope: just this Fano poset, not all projective planes.
